title: WAN Link Failure / Device Reachability
initial_response: Confirm the WAN path, check the router interface, verify alternate-path reachability, and prepare approved failover if needed.
steps: Check reachability from an alternate path.
Compare latency before and after the failure.
Initiate approved failover if the path remains unavailable.
Escalate if the fault domain cannot be confirmed.

title: Authentication Failure Burst
initial_response: Check authentication gateway logs, identify the affected source range, and compare the burst with recent configuration changes.
steps: Review gateway events for the affected window.
Check recent AAA or configuration changes.
Escalate if the cause is not covered.
